title: China Probes Shanghai Boss, Spain Votes Sunday, Ukraine Hits 14 Refineries | Daily Crux
description_html:
China has placed Shanghai's Communist Party chief Chen Jining under corruption investigation, Spain votes this Sunday in an election that could bring the far right into government for the first time since the 1970s, and Ukraine has hit at least 14 Russian oil refineries since the start of November. So what does it mean for you? Today's three main stories explain what is known, what is not, how each affects you wherever you live, and what you should do. Plus world headlines from the United States, Taiwan, Gaza, the Gulf, Russia, Libya and India.
